decisions.reason: As a multi-model system close to the core offer, with an early standalone webpage and several years of sunk engineering and support effort, management would be reluctant to withdraw it absent clear persistent failure.

This product line is less publicly visible than the flagship launches, but its close fit with the firm's modular formwork business and accumulated investment still make continuation more likely than withdrawal.
Its own page, line breadth, and tight connection to the established formwork portfolio create both reputational and sunk-cost pressures to persist with it.
Because it was visibly launched and complements the firm's magnetic formwork offering, management can justify keeping it as part of the broader product family despite any uneven results.

As the least prominently presented and most droppable single component among the remaining products, it faces the highest withdrawal risk, but core fit and prior development still tilt management toward retention.
